title: Update outdated tool versions in the CI pipeline
description:
## What does this MR do?

Updates the tool versions used by the CI pipeline and makes them maintainable by Renovate:

- `helm-unittest` 0.3.4 → 1.2.1, `kind` v0.20.0 → v0.33.0, `kubectl` v1.27.4 → v1.37.1, `docker` 20.10.16 → 29.9.2, `alpine` 3.18 → 3.24.
- Base image `gitlab-build-images:gitlab-charts-build-base-helm-3.7` (Helm 3.7, 2021) → `alpine/helm:${HELM_VERSION}` (3.22.1). `gitlab-build-images` has no newer Helm-only image (the latest is `helm-3.9`). `alpine/helm` ships `git`, `curl` and `bash`, which the `unit_tests` and `release beta` jobs need.
- The integration test installs the same `HELM_VERSION` instead of whatever `get-helm-3` resolves as "latest" (which is now Helm 4).
- `kubectl` is downloaded from `dl.k8s.io`: the legacy `storage.googleapis.com/kubernetes-release` bucket returns 404 for current versions.
- `docker:<version>-git` images are no longer published (last one is 25.0.5); the integration job uses `docker:<version>-cli` instead. The job never needed `git`.
- `release beta` installs `aws-cli` from the Alpine community repository instead of `pip install awscli`, which fails with externally-managed-environment (PEP 668) on Alpine 3.24, the base of `alpine/helm:3.22.1`.
- Every version is a `variables:` entry so that the Renovate bot can bump them (see the linked issue for the bot onboarding MRs).

## Verification

- `helm lint .` and `helm unittest .` pass locally under Helm 3.22.1 with helm-unittest 1.2.1 (89 tests, 3 snapshots).
- `.gitlab-ci.yml` validated with `glab ci lint`.
- The integration tests can only run in the canonical project (they need the `AUTHENTICATION_TOKEN` variable), so please run the MR pipeline from there.

Closes #602
